# TemporalSwitchMechanism

**Domain**: Cross
**First mentioned**: auto-extracted

## Definition
A mechanism that dynamically toggles between different temporal processing strategies or representations based on input characteristics or task demands. It allows neuromorphic systems to adaptively handle varying temporal dynamics, improving robustness and performance in dynamic network environments.
